title: Analysis code: No receptor-binding domain adaptation detected in within-host H5N1 surveillance of 4,559 US dairy outbreak sequences
description: Reproducibility code for a pre-registered, corpus-wide intrahost single-nucleotide variant (iSNV) analysis of all publicly available H5N1 cattle, feline-spillover, and retail-milk sequences on the NCBI Sequence Read Archive (4,559 samples). Includes dual-caller concordance pipeline, adaptation-site prevalence analysis, within-host diversity comparisons, and all figure generation scripts.
